note: Export activity is factually confirmed by customs bill-of-lading records, not by website claims: exporter IE AUTO INDUSTRIAL ENTERPRISE PRIVATE LIMITED (Dadri ICD, India) shipping auto parts to IMPERGOM S.R.L, Genoa, Italy, B/L 1116344, dated 2026-02-28, HS 87089900 and 40169990. Declared HS 870899 matches the observed 87089900 line, so no HS correction is needed; the same consignment also carries 40169990 (rubber engine mountings), i.e. the company ships a mixed HS basket. Note the direction: the free view shows India-origin export lanes (Dadri ICD -> Genoa/Barcelona), and the counterparty table is labelled 'Buyers' with IE Auto as the Indian seller, consistent with an exporter role. Only 2 of the claimed 6051 shipment rows were actually visible, so the 6051 figure is a platform counter and is not independently verified here. Domestic supply evidence could not be established with the available tools — recorded as unknown, not as absent, because the blocking was technical (403/JS challenge) rather than a negative finding. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views and are left null rather than estimated. No sanctions, litigation or ownership issues were assessed in this pass (out of scope for this role).
